# E0105: a version file has a field that is not schema, ForwardLens or BackwardLens

A version file has at most three fields: schema, ForwardLens and BackwardLens.
Anything else is usually a typo; when the name is close to one of the three,
the help names it.

## Example

`ship/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
scehma: {
	a: string
	b: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: 1
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0105]: scehma is not a field of a version file
 --> 1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | scehma: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = help: did you mean Schema?

error[E0108]: 1.0.thema declares no Schema
 --> 1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | scehma: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = help: every version file declares Schema: {...}
```
